Woman Dies Practicing Driving, Nurse Found Dead in Kolkata Hospital

A woman in Kestopur, Kolkata, died when her car plunged into a pond while she was practicing for her driving test. Her body was recovered after 90 minutes. Separately, a nurse was found dead in the bathroom of Kolkata's NRS Medical College and Hospital. In unrelated incidents, a 75-year-old woman died following a burglary in London, and residents of Bengaluru protested for road repairs after a fatal accident.
